summary: Tested the Chez Dina mobile and messaging fixes. Backend: per-user archive for riders and customers plus the console archive, 11/11 pytest pass. Frontend: archive and unarchive work in the rider app, the customer space and the console. No horizontal overflow at 390/430 px on 9 storefront pages, 7 logged-in account and checkout pages, 7 rider pages and 7 console pages. All inputs are 16px or larger on mobile and the viewport meta is correct. The two banners scroll on mobile and are static on desktop after a fresh load. Selected states are visible on storefront and console. I found and fixed one CRITICAL bug: OpeningHoursBanner.jsx used <Marquee> without importing it, so the storefront home page crashed ('Marquee is not defined') whenever the shop was closed. One minor Marquee bug is still open.

minor.issue: The per-user 'archived_for' list is never cleared when a new message arrives. Sends only reset the global 'archived' flag. So a conversation a rider or customer archived stays hidden under 'Archivées' even after the other side replies, unlike the console behaviour. Consider $pull of the recipient ids from archived_for on send (product decision).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: missing `import Marquee from '@/components/shared/Marquee'` crashed the storefront home page (runtime error overlay 'Marquee is not defined') when the shop was closed.

Once scrolling starts, it never stops. measure() uses inner.scrollWidth, and the running span has padding-left:100%, so the measured width is always bigger than the box. Reproduced on the home page at 1920 -> 390 -> 1920: promo-banner and hours-banner-text keep scrolling on desktop. Fresh desktop loads are static as expected. This also hits phone rotation (portrait -> landscape) and tablets. Fix: subtract getComputedStyle(inner).paddingLeft from scrollWidth, or measure a separate unpadded span.

issues: The selected check mark is a #b02a2a circle, so on red or bordeaux swatches ('Rouge', 'Bordeaux') it nearly blends in. Only the ring makes the selection visible. Consider a white or dark check background on dark or red colors.
The per-row archive buttons (msg-archive-{id}) only show on hover, so they are not reachable by tap on touch devices. The in-thread 'thread-archive' button works.

action_items: Fix Marquee.jsx measuring so it can switch back to static: exclude padding-left from the measured width.
Decide whether a new incoming message should clear per-user archived_for (rider and customer inboxes).
Optional: make the color swatch check mark readable on red or bordeaux colors; make console row archive buttons visible on touch devices.
critical_code_review_comments: OpeningHoursBanner used Marquee without importing it (fixed). Add the ESLint rule react/jsx-no-undef so a build/lint check catches this kind of mistake.

Global CSS rule `button.border-[#b02a2a].text-[#b02a2a]` with background !important is broad and couples styling to Tailwind class names. It works today (no button found with these classes permanently on), but a future static outline button with these classes would look 'selected' all the time.
_archive_for is fine: 404 when the user is not a participant, idempotent $addToSet/$pull.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression file: test_iter91_archive.py. The console row archive button only shows on hover; click it through JS. The overflow check walks ancestors because html/body use overflow-x:clip, so scrollWidth alone always equals innerWidth. Re-check the Marquee resize behaviour after the main agent's fix.
rca of the issue: Home crash: OpeningHoursBanner.jsx line 60 renders <Marquee> but the import was never added. It only appeared when the shop was closed (outside opening hours), which is why it could be missed. Marquee latching: when running, the span has class dina-marquee-run with padding-left:100%, so on resize i.scrollWidth = box width + text width, which is always larger than the box, and dur never goes back to 0.
